entwurf.beschreibung: A quick guide showing how to use Anthropic Claude to generate Roblox scripts, with real steps, limits, and a humorous spin.

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: Start by opening Claude and choosing a new project for your Roblox work.
teile.szene: A frustrated indie dev sits at a cluttered desk, steam rising from a coffee mug, laptop screen showing a red error. Neon‑glow city night outside the window, soft street light filters in.
teile.bildtext: Developer frowning at Roblox Studio error screen

teile.name: Project Creation
teile.text: In the project sidebar, upload your existing script files so Claude can reference them during the chat.
teile.szene: The same dev clicks ‘New Project’ in Claude’s sidebar, drags a .lua file onto the interface; a holographic grid lights up around the code.

teile.name: Generate ModuleScript
teile.text: Ask Claude to generate a ModuleScript for player movement; the model will produce code snippets based on the uploaded context.
teile.szene: The dev types a prompt, Claude streams code; the dev highlights the text, drags it into the Explorer window, and watches a tiny avatar sprint.
teile.bildtext: Generated ModuleScript being dropped into Explorer

teile.name: Verify API Compatibility
teile.text: But what if the generated code still fails to compile?
teile.szene: A split‑screen shows Claude’s suggestion on the left, Roblox API page on the right; the dev circles mismatched function names with a red pen.

teile.name: Enjoy Instant Results
teile.text: Check each function against Roblox’s official API docs and adjust any mismatches before running. After testing, you can copy the ModuleScript into Studio's Explorer pane.
teile.szene: The avatar zooms across a neon‑lit arena; the dev leans back, eyes wide, coffee untouched, neon reflections glinting off the screen.
teile.bildtext: Avatar dashing in a neon arena

teile.name: Final Pitch
teile.text: Free users can create up to five projects, so keep your work organized and within that quota.
teile.szene: The presenter, a cartoonish tech host in a game‑poster style jacket, points at a flashing “Play” button, winking at the camera.
teile.bildtext: Presenter inviting viewers to try Claude

teile.name: Call to Action
teile.text: If this helps you level up, like, share, and save this video, thanks for watching.
teile.szene: Bold graphic icons of thumbs‑up, share arrows, and a bookmark bounce on a dark background.
